testCases.title: Verify the sort dropdown is displayed on the product overview page.
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
expectedResults: The sort dropdown is visible on the product overview page.

testCases.title: Verify the sort dropdown includes the correct sorting options.
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
expectedResults: The sort dropdown includes the options: Name (A - Z), Name (Z - A), Price (High - Low), Price (Low - High).

testCases.title: Verify selecting a sort option reloads the product grid in the selected order.
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
Select 'Price (Low - High)' from the sort dropdown.
expectedResults: The product grid reloads and displays products sorted by Price (Low - High).
